ghi: Generate archive: POST /cgi-bin/cgi-backup (tep that, trung tung byte). Upload archive: POST /cgi-bin/cgi-upload (multipart filename/sessionid/file) -> oui.system drop_caches -> hop thoai Checksum/Size -> OK -> oui.system backup_restore -> [0,{code:0}] -> 'Reboot now' -> system reboot. Tep sai -> code 1 + stderr (3 truong hop do); that bai -> 'Close' -> backup_clean. Perform reset / Flash firmware: KHONG do, KHONG gia lap (an toan).
